_comment: Canonical AdminAuditEntry document shape. client is the authority - it appends a record for every admin-side state change (retire, disable, role mutation, etc.) so the lifecycle is auditable from the protocol Gateway. A field mismatch breaks admin audit trails and compliance reporting.

admin_audit_entry._description: Single admin action audit record. Append-only. New admin-side state changes MUST append a row here.

action.description: Admin action type. Stable string value - downstream tooling joins on this. E.g. 'retire_local_owner'.

actor.description: User ID of the admin who performed the action.

target.description: User ID or resource ID that was the target of the action.

operator_id.description: Operator ID involved in the action, if applicable.

noop.description: True when the action was a no-op (target was already in the desired state).

at.description: When the admin action occurred (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z suffix).
